title: An EmDash chain build names its slot contract, opens its picture kit and needs no webroot seal
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed and TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: slotNamesOfKit names emdash-tracy-diner for the JA Diner EmDash kit (asking platform emdash, its tag and version) and keeps the Joomla names for a Joomla kit; openKitWithMap opens the EmDash kit with its content map; a brief run on EmDash with requiresSetupHold and an unproven opening seal applies its writes, its setup commit does nothing and no webroot is closed, while a refused seal still stops a WordPress run.

tests: the brand step names the EmDash release slot contract, never a Joomla one of the same product
the picture bench opens every kit it lists, the EmDash one with its content map
an EmDash run needs no webroot seal: its writes go on, and committing the setup is nothing to do
a required setup hold refusal prevents all scripted and native writes
